name: economy
notes: DESIGN §7.5 economy suite (>= 30). Every case is a single decisive action (one MOVE for a relocation choice, or PROMOTE_UNIT vs END_PLACE_PHASE for a promote-vs-bank choice) rather than a full four-action turn: the M11 turn generator this suite is meant to be scored against (DESIGN §7.5, measurement-first.md) does not exist yet at M8, so "end position" here is the position right after the one action the case is actually testing. best/avoid Kpos values are computed by literally applying that action through the canonical engine (src/ai/simulate.ts applyAction) and packing the result (src/ai/hard/core/state.ts Replica.pack), not hand-copied.
